world.title: 四个参数迭代生成 Clifford 吸引子
world.posterTitle: Clifford 映射形成确定性的点云结构
world.posterHook: Clifford 吸引子：每一步只是 sin 与 cos 的交错；十万次之后，翅膀、丝带与暗涡在纯黑里浮现。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Clifford 映射 · 本地构建
world.question: 为什么四个数字反复迭代，会落成一片星云？
world.hook: 每一步只是 sin 与 cos 的交错；十万次之后，平面上浮现出翅膀、丝带与暗涡。
world.payoff: Clifford 吸引子是二维迭代映射：有界却对初值敏感。参数 (a,b,c,d) 决定折叠方式——同一规则在不同系数下会长出完全不同的尘埃纹样。

en.title: Four parameters generate a Clifford attractor
en.posterTitle: The Clifford map forms a deterministic point cloud
en.posterHook: Clifford attractor: each step is only interlaced sin and cos; after a hundred thousand steps, wings, ribbons, and dark eddies appear on pure black.
en.question: Why does iterating four numbers settle into a nebula?
en.hook: Each step is only interlaced sin and cos; after a hundred thousand steps, wings, ribbons, and dark eddies rise on the plane.
en.payoff: The Clifford attractor is a 2D iterative map: bounded yet sensitive to initial conditions. Parameters (a,b,c,d) choose the fold — the same rule grows entirely different dust patterns under different coefficients.
